To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) We present a novel subset optimization method to generate a compact and accurate set of detection windows for unconstrained salient objects; and 2) The subset optimization method greatly enhances the performance, and our system achieves the state-of-the-arts on three salient object datasets.

(1) our system directly outputs a compact detection window set for an input image; (2) our system achieves state-of-the-art performance on three challenging saliency datasets, and attains a relative improvement of 16-34%; and (3) our system is the first to address salient object detection in unconstrained images, and is the first to use subset optimization for salient object detection.

(1) we propose a subset optimization framework to select a compact subset out of a large set of proposals for unconstrained salient object detection; (2) our subset optimization framework is a generic optimization framework that can be easily integrated with any saliency models; (3) we show that our salient object detection framework, which is based on a CNN and our subset optimization framework, attains state-of-the-art performance on several salient object detection benchmarks.
